UTILITIES / CALCULATOR STUDIO

Make room for the numbers.

Calculate scientific expressions, fractions and percentages with DEG or RAD angles.

A little help with the numbers

Use + − * / ^ !, parentheses, pi, e, ans; sqrt, cbrt, abs, ln, log10, exp, round, floor, ceil, sin/cos/tan and asin/acos/atan. % always means divide by 100. Scalar real values only.

Your result

≈ marks an approximation. Decimal display uses up to 34 significant digits; fraction display is an approximation.
